_about: FFIEC v1 test-vector case 017 expected verifier output for the partial-disclosure mode per design 07 §10.3. A conforming verifier processing entries.json + seal.json + partial-proof-entry-3.json with a registry-anchored public key matching seal.public_key_id MUST produce output matching this shape. Hash and signature placeholder values pass through; the structural shape (field names, ordering, the completeness_assertion field, the per-entry breakdown, the banner) is normative.
banner:
PARTIAL-DISCLOSURE VERIFICATION
This report attests inclusion of the named entries in the sealed root.
This report does NOT attest chain completeness for tenant_day 2026-05-08.
_exit_code_reference: design 07 §10.9 maps PASS to exit 0; spec §10.12 governs the broader exit-code contract. Exit 0 here means: every disclosed entry passed P1-P5 and the per-batch P4 seal signature validated against the registry-anchored public key.
_failure_modes_not_exercised_in_this_cas: P1 leaf-hash mismatch (would emit 'leaf hash mismatch at seq 4' and exit 1)
P2 invalid audit-path position (would emit 'invalid audit-path position at seq 4' and exit 1)
P3 root mismatch (would emit 'audit path does not lead to sealed root at seq 4' and exit 1)
P4 seal signature failure (would emit 'signature verification failed' and exit 1)
P5 tenant cross-bind (would emit 'tenant_id mismatch at seq 4: entry not bound to disclosed seal' and exit 1)
Structural input error (malformed bundle, missing files; exit 2)
Configuration error (tenant not in registry, snapshot pre-dates tenant_day; exit 3)
